ns2:section.sectionText: Lectures begin on Monday, 16 June, 2014 and Discussions begin on Tuesday, 17 June, 2014. Hourly examinations will be held on the following Wednesday evenings from 5:00-7:00pm: July 2, July 16, and July 30, 2014. Final exams are scheduled through Aug. 9, 2014. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differetnial tuition during the term of course enrollment.
